_note: Copy this to policies/<reference>.json. Real documents are gitignored.

facts._comment: Figures and flags exactly as they appear on the schedule. If it is not here the agent does not know it and will escalate rather than estimate.

sections: Name each section the agent may quote from. It cannot quote what is not listed.

wording._comment: VERBATIM text, section by section. This is the only thing the agent is allowed to say a policy says — see LEGAL.md. Do not summarise, do not simplify, do not modernise the language. A paraphrase here becomes a policy term the firm is answerable for.
